other_conditions: Beneficiary must be one of the first two daughters of the mother
Mother or father must not be permanently employed or retired from Central/State Government or Public Sector Undertakings, and must not receive any pension or family pension from such employers
Mother must not be an income taxpayer and must submit a self‑declaration confirming the above
Beneficiary must be studying in schools run or aided by the Government/Scheduled Tribes, Scheduled Castes, Minority or Backward Classes Welfare Department of Jharkhand
benefits_summary: Cash assistance of ₹2,500–₹5,000 for schoolgirls (classes 8‑12) and a one‑time grant of ₹20,000 for girls aged 18‑19.
